# Vitest Testing Framework

Curated by Skill Harbor — a practical guide to Vitest, the next-generation testing framework powered by Vite: configuration and Vite integration, the test/describe/expect APIs, hooks, mocking, spies, snapshot testing, coverage via V8 or Istanbul, test filtering, and fixtures. Jest-compatible API with native ESM, TypeScript, and JSX support out of the box — shares the same config, transformers, resolvers, and plugins as the Vite app. By @antfu (Anthony Fu), listed here with credit to its creator; generated from the official vitest-dev/vitest repository. Honest caveats: the skill snapshot is based on Vitest 5.0.1 — newer Vitest versions may have changed some APIs; it guides test writing, it doesn't run the test suite for you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
